query: I'm writing a review paper on soil microbiome responses to drought. Can you help me set up strands, collect papers into cards with BibTeX, and keep every claim traceable to a source?
Write the Background section for my grant on wearable EEG for epilepsy monitoring: synthesize the last ten years of work thematically and end with the gap we fill.
I need a scoping review of LLM-based tutoring systems in K-12. Where do I even start with finding and organizing the papers?
Can you pull together what's been published on microplastics in freshwater fish and tell me where the open questions are?
our lab wants a direction paper on federated learning for hospital imaging, grounded in the actual literature, not vibes. help me plan the phases
Here's my finished paper on coral bleaching. Check that every reference in the .bib actually exists and supports the sentence it's cited in.
I have results from a field trial on cover crops. Draft the Introduction and Methods sections for Agronomy Journal.
Take my idea about graph neural networks for protein docking all the way to a full review-ready manuscript, lit search included.
